name: luvyo
description: LUVYO – Philippine Mobility App. Multimodal route, fare and travel-time planner for the Philippines.

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build-static.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
